name: Beijing Shiji Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Shiji Information Technology Co., Ltd. provides software solutions and information technology services for the hospitality, food service, retail, leisure, and entertainment industries in China and internationally. It offers Daylight PMS, a hotel management system; Infrasys Pro, a cloud catering management system; Reviewpro, a reputation management system; Horizon distribution platform; Iceportal content management system; Meridian Experience value-added solution; Astral payment platform; Stellaris digital ecosystem; and Twilight Data + AI intelligence platform. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
